Terms & warranty

Terms and Conditions

This estimate is valid for 30 days from the issue date. Final price may vary based on site conditions discovered during installation.

Estimate Terms & Conditions

  1. Scope of Work: This estimate includes only the work specifically listed. Any additional work, changes, or unforeseen conditions will require a written change order and may affect pricing and timeline.
  2. Pricing Validity: This estimate is valid for 30 days from the issue date. Prices may change after this period.
  3. Deposit Requirement: A deposit is required to schedule the project. Work will not begin until the deposit is received.
  4. Scheduling: Project start dates are estimated and may change due to material availability, weather, or unforeseen conditions.
  5. Material Responsibility: If the customer provides materials, the contractor is not responsible for defects, compatibility issues, or performance of those materials.
  6. Site Conditions: The client must ensure the work area is accessible and cleared of furniture and personal items unless otherwise agreed in writing.
  7. Subfloor / Prep Disclaimer: Any subfloor issues or additional preparation required beyond the initial scope will be charged separately.

Contract Agreement

  1. Agreement: By approving this estimate, the client agrees to all terms and authorizes the contractor to perform the work described.
  2. Payment Terms: Deposit due before start. Remaining balance due upon completion. Late payments may incur fees.
  3. Change Orders: Any changes must be approved in writing and may affect price and timeline.
  4. Delays: Contractor is not responsible for delays caused by weather, material shortages, unforeseen site conditions, or third-party work.
  5. Client Responsibilities: Client must provide access to the property, maintain proper indoor conditions (temperature/humidity), and remove personal items unless otherwise agreed.
  6. Flooring Variations: Client understands that wood, vinyl, and laminate may have natural color and shade variations, and that expansion, contraction, and minor gaps are normal.

Workmanship Warranty (1 Year)

The contractor provides a 1-year warranty on installation workmanship starting from the project completion date. This warranty covers installation defects caused by improper workmanship, such as loose planks, improper fitting, or installation-related failures. This warranty does NOT cover: material defects (covered by the manufacturer), water damage, moisture issues or flooding, improper maintenance or cleaning, normal wear and tear (scratches, dents, fading), damage caused by pets, furniture, or abuse, structural or subfloor movement, or environmental conditions (humidity, temperature changes). If a valid claim is made, the contractor will repair the affected area at no cost.
